description: Create a multi-root workspace file at '/home/ga/projects/microservices.code-workspace' that includes three project folders: 'auth-service', 'shared-models', and 'api-gateway' (all located in /home/ga/projects/). The workspace file must be a valid JSON file with a 'folders' array containing all three project directories. You can either: (1) Use File menu → 'Add Folder to Workspace' three times to add each folder, then 'Save Workspace As' and save to /home/ga/projects/microservices.code-workspace, OR (2) Manually create the .code-workspace JSON file with the required structure and open it. The workspace should allow working across all three microservice repositories simultaneously.
